description: PATCH with a password against a postgres DSN is allowed -- unlike sqlite3 (a local file with no network credential at all, see the sqlite suite's dsns-94f), postgres has a real credential to rotate. UpdateDSNHandler's sqlite-only rejection block never applies here. The response never echoes the actual password back, elided or not -- it always reports the fixed placeholder "********", for every provider

tests.name: password is never echoed back, even elided
